name: Demo Filer
narrative: Switched jobs mid-year (Employer A Apr-Sep, Employer B Oct-Mar). Each employer independently gave a full standard deduction in its own Form 16, without knowing about the other employer -- so simply adding both Form 16 'taxable income' figures double-counts the standard deduction (Rs 1,00,000 claimed vs Rs 50,000 actually allowed under the old regime). Prefers the old regime because of HRA + 80C + 80D, but if the return is filed by naively summing both Form 16s, CPC's 143(1) processing disallows the extra standard deduction and raises a demand.
